notes.zh: 审阅注：局势从75%开始（第三阶段）。拯救方案每月-7（加倍努力再-3），进度向下，依次进入第二、第一阶段并在0时成功；观测/掠夺方案每月+3（每年再+1，五年后+10），进度向上进入第四阶段并在100时失败。图中由编译器自动生成的“阶段”顺延连接（9855→9875、9875→9870、9860→9880、9880→9855）不是实际顺序，以审阅连接为准。
notes.en: Review note: the situation starts at 75% (stage 3). The rescue approach subtracts 7/month (3 more when redoubled), so progress falls through stages 2 and 1 to success at 0; observing or plundering adds 3/month (+1 per year, +10 after five years), rising through stage 4 to loss at 100. The compiler's automatic 'next stage' links (9855→9875, 9875→9870, 9860→9880, 9880→9855) are not the real order; follow the reviewed links.

notes.zh: 审阅注：这是“负相物质”事件链的后半段。前半段（传送门 colony.3005 → 研究项目 → 9800 虚无次元 → 9805 → 9810 负质量 → 9815 传送门出现并派出舰队）目前在另一个故事中；击败那支熟悉的舰队（on_fleet_destroyed_perp，舰队方带 B_world_relation 关系标记）即触发本篇。
notes.en: Review note: this is the second half of the Negative Mass chain. The first half (The Doorway colony.3005 → portal project → 9800 → 9805 → 9810 Negative Mass → 9815 the portal and its fleet) currently sits in another story; destroying that familiar fleet (on_fleet_destroyed_perp, attacker flagged B_world_relation) starts this story.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选择“多一朵镜中花”会在120天后再次触发本事件。
notes.en: Review note: "Two is better than one" schedules this event again 120 days later.
